decision.completeness_basis: Majors list on the 'University Catalog 2026-2027' Undergraduate page (stored only in the discovery run). Its bachelor-level entries (BS, BA, Bachelor, Double Major), mostly 'Major (BS): X Concentration', collapse to 101 major+award programs, the same count as the reviewed record; the two spellings of Parks, Recreation(,) and Tourism Management (BS) count as one. Excluded: AAS, minors, certificates, and first-year, exploratory and transfer entries. Counted though unsure: the 2 Mathematics Education double majors, and Biological Engineering (BS, concentration lines only) separately from Biological, Agricultural, and Ecological Engineering (BS, its own bare page without concentrations). 93 of the 101 have a verified record: 61 on the bare-major page and 32 through concentration records because the list prints them only through concentration lines (Agricultural Education (BS), Agroecology & Sustainable Food Systems (BS), Animal Science (BS), Anthropology (BA), Arts Studies (BA), Biological Engineering (BS), Crop and Soil Sciences (BS), Elementary Education (BS), Engineering (BS), English (BA), Fashion and Textile Design (BS), Fashion and Textile Management (BS), Fisheries, Wildlife, and Conservation Biology (BS), Food Science (BS), Forest Management (BS), Horticultural Science (BS), Interdisciplinary Studies (BA), Interdisciplinary Studies (BS), International Studies (BA), Leadership in the Public Sector (BA), Marine Sciences (BS), Mathematics Education (BS), Middle Grades Education (BS), Natural Resources (BS), Parks, Recreation and Tourism Management (BS), Polymer and Color Chemistry (BS), Poultry Science (BS), Psychology (BA), Science Education (BS), Technology, Engineering and Design Education (BS), Textile Engineering (BS), World Languages and Cultures (BA)). Each entry counted once. Still without a verified record: Architecture (Bachelor); Environmental Design in Architecture (Bachelor); Graphic & Experience Design (Bachelor); Industrial Design (Bachelor); Mathematics Education (BS) and Mathematics (BS) (Double Major); Mathematics Education (BS) and Statistics (BS) (Double Major); Media Arts, Design and Technology (Bachelor); Social Work (Bachelor).
